method.aggregation: source pixels assigned to the 0.25 degree cell containing their centre; a land pixel is one above 0 m (the file stores ocean as 0 m, not as a fill value, so true land at exactly 0 m is counted as sea); elevation = mean over land pixels; land_fraction = land pixels / all pixels; terrain land = land_fraction >= 0.5; land cell = terrain land OR IMD footprint cell (protocol v2 and v3)
method.coast_normal: unit gradient of the 3x3-mean land mask, pointing landward (the direction of onshore flow)
method.distance_to_coast: great-circle km from the cell centre to the nearest ocean cell centre of the land-sea mask over the extended grid
method.footprint: time-invariant IMD valid-cell set (identical in every 2023 and 2024 case); the set of cells only, no rainfall value
method.local_relief: max minus min of the aggregated mean elevation over land cells of the 3x3 neighbourhood (ocean cells excluded)
method.terrain_gradient: non-land cells and land cells with undefined elevation at 0 m, one 3x3 mean, central differences; slope in m per km; unit vector pointing uphill
